text: Call Issued: March 15, 2019 Call Closed: April 30, 2019 Number of Addenda Issued: Two (2) Number of Bids: 1 Table 2: Summary of Bids Received for Request for Quotation No. 3412-19-0093 including bid price Bidder Bid Price (including H.S.T.) ONX Enterprise Solutions Ltd. $5,023,252.28

Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (June 6, 2019) from the Chief Purchasing Officer Call Number: Request for Quotation No. 3412-19-0093 Description: For the non-exclusive supply, delivery, installation, maintenance and professional services of HDS Storage and related support for a period of five (5) years from the date of award. Recommended Bidder: ONX Enterprise Solutions Ltd.
